description: This is a Java class implementing a service layer for managing recipes, including CRUD operations and search functionalities, within a Spring Boot application.

classes.name: RecipeService
classes.description: Service class providing operations for creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, listing, and searching recipes.

methods.name: toDto
methods.description: Converts a Recipe entity to a RecipeResponse DTO.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new recipe from the provided request DTO and author ID, returns the created recipe as DTO.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a recipe by ID, throws NotFoundException if not found.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing recipe identified by ID with data from the request DTO.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists all recipes with pagination, sorted by creation date descending.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Searches recipes by title, ingredients, and tags with pagination.

methods.name: csvToSet
methods.description: Converts a comma-separated string into a set of trimmed strings.
